# YUVA

> YUVA is a leading NGO driving youth empowerment, education, and community development across Mauritius and India.

YUVA operates as a charitable organization focused on creating social impact through education support, volunteer opportunities, and donation campaigns. The organization serves communities in key locations including Port Louis (Mauritius) and Mumbai (India).
